name: AdaptHealth Corp.
summary:
AdaptHealth (AHCO) reported earnings of $0.03 per share on revenue of $740.31 million for the second quarter ended June 2026. The consensus estimate was a loss of $0.01 per share on revenue of $861.62 million. The company beat consensus estimates by 400.00% while revenue fell 7.50% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said, with the divestiture in its Diabetes Health business, it now expects 2026 revenue of $2.85 billion to $2.89 billion. The company's previous guidance was revenue of $3.45 billion to $3.52 billion, and the current consensus revenue estimate is $3.50 billion for the year ending December 31, 2026.

AdaptHealth is a national leader in providing patient-centric and technology enabled chronic disease management solutions including home healthcare equipment, medical supplies to the home and related services in the United States.
subject: AdaptHealth Beat Consensus Estimates
